% macros.tex -- author macros, read by body/paper.tex in the preamble.
\chardef\gmsavedatcode=\catcode`\@ % [T6] catcode saved in a \chardef ...
\catcode`\@=11                      % ... an explicit \catcode in an author file

% [M1] symbol aliases and control-symbol names
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\def\eps{{\epsilon}}
\newcommand{\1}{\mathbf{1}}
\newcommand\gmeps\varepsilon% [M13] unbraced body
\renewcommand{\>}{\rangle}% [M15] renewing a kernel control symbol
% [M2] operators and paired delimiters
\DeclareMathOperator*{\argmin}{arg\,min}
\DeclareMathOperator{\Tr}{Tr}
\DeclarePairedDelimiter\norm{\lVert}{\rVert}
\DeclarePairedDelimiterX\inner[2]{\langle}{\rangle}{#1,#2}
\newcommand{\abs}[1]{\left\lvert #1 \right\rvert}
% [M3] text macros
\newcommand{\gmname}{\textsc{GM}\xspace}
\newcommand{\gmfix}{\marginpar{FIX}}
\newcommand{\gmcard}[2][Note]{\textbf{#1:} #2}% [M4] optional-argument default
\providecommand{\gmagent}[1]{\textsc{#1}}
\newcommand*{\gmseven}[7]{#1#2#3#4#5#6#7}% [M5] seven parameters
% [M6] conditional and expansion control in bodies
\newcommand{\gmpp}{\ifmmode\mathrm{pp}\else pp\fi}
\newcommand{\gmifempty}[3]{\if\relax\detokenize{#1}\relax#2\else#3\fi}
\newcommand{\gmrnum}[1]{\uppercase\expandafter{\romannumeral #1\relax}}
% [M7] delimited parameters and a #{ parameter
\def\gmpair(#1,#2){\langle #1,#2\rangle}
\def\gmmathcolor#1#{\gm@mathcolor{#1}}% #1 is whatever precedes the first {
\def\gm@mathcolor#1#2#3{{\color#1{#2}#3}}
% [M8] comments by macro: discard the argument, or show it under a flag
\newcommand{\gmignore}[1]{}
\newif\ifgmdraftnotes
\newcommand{\gmnote}[1]{\ifgmdraftnotes\textcolor{red}{[#1]}\fi}

% [N14] definitions that define
\newcommand\gmblfootnote[1]{\begingroup
  \renewcommand\thefootnote{}\footnote{#1}\addtocounter{footnote}{-1}\endgroup}
\newcommand\gmdefpair[2]{\def#1##1{[#2:##1]}}% inner ## parameters
\gmdefpair\gmtagA{A}
\newcommand*\gmmakecheck[1]{%
  \expandafter\newcommand\csname #1check\endcsname{\textcolor{#1}{\checkmark}}}
\gmmakecheck{red}\gmmakecheck{blue}
\newcommand{\gmsetcap}[2]{\expandafter\def\csname gmcap@#1\endcsname{#2}}
\gmsetcap{fig1}{0.75}% tested later with \ifcsname
\@namedef{gm@named}{a macro named through \string\@namedef}
% [N15] \let: to \relax and \undefined, a chain, and save-and-wrap
\let\gmnothing\relax
\let\gmgone\undefined
\let\gmbase\textbf
\let\gmmid\gmbase
\let\gmtop\gmmid
\let\gmoldparagraph\paragraph
\renewcommand{\paragraph}{\gmparahook\gmoldparagraph}
\newcommand{\gmparahook}{\typeout{paragraph}}
% [N16] kernel idioms: \@ifstar, \@ifnextchar, a patch of an optional-argument internal
\newcommand{\gmsec}{\@ifstar{\section*}{\section}}
\newcommand{\gmextp}{\@ifnextchar^\gm@extp{\gm@extp^{\,}}}
\def\gm@extp^#1{\mathop{\Lambda}\nolimits^{#1}}
\newcommand{\gmopt}[1][dflt]{(#1)}
\expandafter\patchcmd\csname\string\gmopt\endcsname{(}{[}{}{\typeout{gmopt: patch failed}}
\NewDocumentCommand{\gmstarred}{s O{} m}{\IfBooleanTF{#1}{#3*}{#3}#2}% [M14] xparse
\AtBeginDocument{\typeout{gauntlet-master: document begins}}
% [M9] environments and theorems
\newenvironment{gmpacked}{\begin{itemize}\setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}}{\end{itemize}}
\newcolumntype{C}{>{$}c<{$}}
\theoremstyle{plain}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\theoremstyle{definition}
\newtheorem*{remark*}{Remark}
\renewcommand*{\thetheorem}{\thesection.\arabic{theorem}}% [M10] \renewcommand*
% [X7] math alphabet declarations (iclr math_commands pattern)
\DeclareMathAlphabet{\mathsfit}{\encodingdefault}{\sfdefault}{m}{sl}
\SetMathAlphabet{\mathsfit}{bold}{\encodingdefault}{\sfdefault}{bx}{n}
\providecommand{\R}{\mathbf{R}}\renewcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}% [M11] the same name again
% [S3] algpseudocode keywords renamed, and a new statement command
\renewcommand{\algorithmicrequire}{\textbf{Input:}}
\renewcommand{\algorithmicensure}{\textbf{Output:}}
\algnewcommand{\LineComment}[1]{\State \(\triangleright\) #1}
\crefname{lemma}{lemma}{lemmas}% [S4] cleveref names for a shared-counter theorem
\setlist{itemsep=1pt}% [S1] global enumitem settings
\captionsetup{font=small,labelfont=bf}% [S7]
% [K12] comment environments made by the comment package
\excludecomment{gmhidden}
\includecomment{gmshown}
\catcode`\@=\gmsavedatcode % [T6] restored
\endinput
